note: Synthetic no-op B3 (MG) mock: it contributes a real burst-stage damage profile so control comps aren't missing the B3 nuke entirely. On its own burst cast it gains ATK ▲ 50% and Attack Damage ▲ 100% for 10s (1.5 × 2 = 3× total), covering the Full Burst it initiates; it does not get the buff on rotations where a different B3 bursts. The buffs are intentionally simple and do not replace a real unit's kit. Using MG weapon timing means reload-speed bonuses interact with the real wind-up ladder.
